clinic.name: Reclamation Clinic
clinic.description: You wake beneath a sign: REPLACEMENT IS NOT A REFUND. The clerk slides your old coat through a hatch. It fits like an accusation. A printer adds another line to your account.

steps.name: Clinic Steps
steps.description: Rain ticks on a roof made of expired safety notices. Far below the street, a pump coughs in its sleep. Someone has chalked FREE WATER over a tariff schedule. Someone else has underlined the fine.

square.name: Toll Square
square.description: A dry fountain holds a queue of patient buckets. Water technician Iona is listening to the pavement with a stolen stethoscope. The district has seventeen minutes of pressure left. The estimate is painted on a permanent sign.

kiosk.name: Ration Kiosk
kiosk.description: A vending machine offers nutrition, consolation, and an apology in three payment plans. Its medical drawer still works. A small placard reads: buy medical supplies (8 credits).

alley.name: Scrap Alley
alley.description: Stripped appliances lean together like exhausted commuters. A gutter scavenger is pricing your teeth by sight. Under a dead refrigerator lies the ceramic pump component Iona needs.

tunnel.name: Service Tunnel
tunnel.description: Pipes cross the ceiling like the handwriting of a frightened engineer. A maintenance arrow points east toward the sump. A dry recess offers a moment to rest.

sump.name: Drain Sump
sump.description: The water is luminous and has opinions. An escaped sump creature kneads a corporate logo in the sludge. Its patent tag is still attached. [RAD] Exposure here: 8 per world action.

pump.name: Pump Hall
pump.description: The last municipal pump shudders inside a cage of brass ribs. An empty ceramic socket spits blue sparks. Someone has left a mug beneath the leak. The mug says TEAMWORK.

booth.name: Control Booth
booth.description: A control console waits for a working pump. Its two receivers are labeled COMMONS and LEASE. The lettering is worn off COMMONS. The keyboard is worn off LEASE.

gate.name: Security Gate
gate.description: A contract guard stands under a camera that has been dead for years. He has orders to protect the water from the people currently drinking it.

relay.name: Rooftop Relay
relay.description: The city looks almost habitable from here. An aerial sends unpaid invoices into the weather. A relay lamp still blinks: somebody, somewhere, is accepting them.

yard.name: Freight Yard
yard.description: Freight containers bear destinations that no longer exist. Broker Moth has built a shop in one marked RETURN TO SENDER. He sells survival without making promises.
